{
  "dataset_name": "customer_churn_classification_nominal",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "age_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized age using training mean and std; older customers tend to churn more.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 6.5],
      "feature_family": "normalized_demographics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth continuous age signal centered at zero for linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 38.0717) / 8.9988"
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_score_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Min-max normalized credit score within the observed range [350, 850].",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_financial",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounded smooth feature for linear projections.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "clip((creditscore - 350.0) / 500.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "balance_to_salary_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-compressed balance over estimated salary ratio for smooth scale.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio_financial",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses heavy-tailed ratio into a near-linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "log1p(balance / (estimatedsalary + 1.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "zero_balance_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that the account holds zero balance.",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "financial_state",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Discrete shift contributing to a separable linear term.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(balance <= 0.0, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "inactive_senior_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Continuous interaction between inactivity and older age (age relative to mean).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 60.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction_behavior",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Composite risk axis suitable for linear separator.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(1 - isactivemember) * np.maximum(age - 38.0717, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "product_extremity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Distance from typical product count of 2; very low/high counts signal churn.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "product_behavior",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Symmetric continuous severity score aligned with linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(numofproducts - 2.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "germany_flag_weighted",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Germany geography indicator (known higher-churn region) blended with inactivity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "geo_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Geo-interaction term boosting linear separability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "germany + germany * (1 - isactivemember)"
    },
    {
      "name": "tenure_per_age_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized tenure_age ratio scaled to [0,1] by max observed.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "loyalty",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth loyalty proxy.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "clip(tenure_age / 0.5556, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "balance_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized balance using training mean and std.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_financial",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linearized balance signal centered at zero.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(balance - 56663.099) / 62792.838"
    },
    {
      "name": "engagement_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of activity, card ownership, and product count breadth.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "engagement_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Hand-crafted linear composite for SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "isactivemember * 2.0 + hascrcard * 1.0 + clip(numofproducts, 1.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "financial_stress_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of financial stress combining high balance with low salary and zero-product diversity; computed as weighted normalized signal.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "judgment_financial_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth severity axis for linear separation of stressed accounts.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "log1p(balance / 10000.0) * np.where(numofproducts == 1, 1.0, 0.5) + np.where(estimatedsalary < 50000.0, 0.5, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "demographic_churn_propensity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic composite reflecting demographic groups historically associated with attrition (older female customers in Germany), expressed as a continuous weighted score.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "judgment_demographic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Single interpretable axis aligning multiple weak demographic signals for linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "clip((age - 38.0717) / 20.0, 0.0, 2.0) + female * 0.5 + germany * 1.0 + (1 - isactivemember) * 0.5"
    }
  ]
}
